# Itzam.ai

> Itzam.ai is an AI agency for LATAM operators. Senior engineers design, build, and ship production-grade AI systems — agents, copilots, and automations — in 30 days, not 30 months. Headquartered in Mexico, serving Latin America and the United States in English and Spanish.

## What we do

Itzam.ai turns AI from a slide deck into something a team uses on Monday morning. Every engagement ends with a working system and a measurable outcome.

- AI Opportunity Assessment — a senior diagnostic that maps where AI compounds in your business, what to build first, and what not to build.
- AI Agents — autonomous workflows that act, not just chat: data pulls, decisions, integrations, escalations.
- AI Copilots — domain-tuned assistants embedded in your stack (sales, ops, support, finance, legal).
- AI Automation — production-grade pipelines that replace manual handoffs end-to-end.

## Who we work with

- LATAM mid-market and enterprise operators (Mexico first, Spanish-speaking LATAM second, US-LATAM corridors third).
- Teams that want production AI, not pilots.
- CEOs, COOs, CIOs, CTOs and Heads of Operations / Revenue / Customer Experience.

## How we work

- Senior-only delivery. The people who design also build.
- Pragmatism over theater — the simplest stack that solves the problem.
- Fixed-scope, fixed-time engagements. 30 days to a deliverable, not 30 months.
- Bilingual (English / Spanish). LATAM-native. US-fluent.

## Founders

- Carlos Bueso — CEO & Co-founder. 25+ years scaling AI, cloud, and data platforms across LATAM and North America. Cisco, Rackspace, Microsoft, Experis.
- Carlos Adrián Bueso — CTO & Co-founder. Software engineer / computer scientist. Co-founder & CTO of Alquimia Studio. Previously quantitative software engineer at AllianceBernstein. Currently developing Voxcentra, an AI-native generative-cinema project.

## Identity

- Brand: Itzam (named after Itzamná, the Mayan god of knowledge).
- Tagline: Intelligence, deployed.
- Languages: English, Spanish.
- Locales: en-US, es-MX.
